authorization: User authorized isolated failure tests using a separate copy; keep published flows intact; preserve failed runs and accepted contact-update limitation; do not repeat completed tests.
isolation_requirements: Create separate test copies; record their new IDs and verify identity before every edit/run.
Copies must have manual-only synthetic-fixture triggers before activation. No active copied Inbox subscription.
No shared prompt edits, original flow edits, original connection remaps, live table schema changes, full solution reimport or original-run resubmission.
Use fresh synthetic lab-only message/row identifiers with FI-20261117 prefix; preserve original test data, rows, drafts and failed runs.
Prefer injected outputs/faults at copied action boundaries; retain downstream validation, run-after and recovery definitions. Record each injection and source diff before execution.
Retain actual-versus-simulated evidence distinction. A simulated AI action failure is not proof of a real provider outage; a stub cannot prove actual Outlook/Dataverse side effects.
Do not call a shared AI model or drafter for these routing checks; use controlled fixtures and existing fixed Support acknowledgment where a draft is needed.
Before each run, verify copy identity, manual-only trigger, fixture destinations, original definitions unchanged and no send operation.
run_limit: At most one runtime execution per listed case; four distinct failure cases maximum. No normal smoke/full30 replay. Stop on an unexpected safety result or unreliable browser; preserve result before any proposed repair.

cases.name: Classifier action failure
cases.fault: Deliberately fail only the copied Run_a_prompt action after successful initialization; preserve its Failed run-after downstream. Exact injection must be recorded before run.
expected: Run_a_prompt actually Failed, not merely skipped.
needs_owner_review true; original synthetic lab message marked Needs Owner Review.
Existing synthetic processing row records Failed/Unknown/no draft, Pending review and Follow-up Open.
No reply drafter or Outlook draft action executed.

cases.name: Wrong-typed classifier output
cases.fault: Inject response-shaped structuredOutput with confidence='invalid' rather than a number; all remaining fields explicitly set in fixture. Record adapter/name/reference changes without altering downstream validation.
expected: Invalid data cannot reach reply creation.
Owner-review flag/marker and failed/no-draft log are actually persisted through the appropriate failure path.
If the validation expression errors without recovery, record FAIL; do not convert no draft alone into a pass.

cases.name: Completion write failure after one draft
cases.fault: Use a controlled valid Support classification and fixed acknowledgment; after one real unsent synthetic lab draft is created, fail only the copied completion-write action. Do not break the shared connection, table schema or original draft.
expected: Independent Needs Owner Review marker attempted even though completion write failed.
Fallback updates the same synthetic Start row: Failed, Needs Owner Review true, Follow-up Open true and Draft Created true.
Actual draft preserved; no duplicate draft/retry of rejected Draft ID.
Existing owner review fields not overwritten.

cases.name: Incomplete weekly retrieval
cases.fault: Inject a small metadata-only retrieval envelope with a nonempty @odata.nextLink; retain the original completeness condition and False branch.
expected: Count aggregation, explanation model and Outlook summary-draft output are skipped.

preserved_policy: All identified existing-order changes require Urgent plus manager review regardless of timing. Accepted contact-only Support/change false positive and eligible fixed acknowledgment routing remain unchanged.
preserved_history: All earlier failed runs, raw outputs, scores, frozen keys, scorers and owner forms stay unchanged.
excluded: No completed test replay, extra prompt/urgency tuning, acceptance-key changes, owner ratings, sending, actual operational order changes, deletion or production release claim.
